info.name: Mukhamar API
info.description: API collection for the Mukhamar marketplace (Arabian perfumes & oud). Run Register or Login first so the apiToken variable is captured, then use the authenticated requests. Switch the app language with the X-Locale header (en | ar).

request.description: List the active onboarding slides (localized).
Home screen bundle: categories, featured products and best sellers.

query.description: Optional filter: perfume | dehen | incense | home | gifts

request.description: List active categories ordered by sort_order.

variable.description: Category slug, e.g. women-perfumes, men-perfumes, oud-oil, incense

request.description: Paginated products belonging to a category.

query.description: Optional boolean, true to return only featured products

request.description: Paginated product listing with filtering, search and sorting.
Carousel of featured products (max 10).

variable.description: Product slug, e.g. classic-oud-mukhamar, najd-nights, royal-luxury-incense

request.description: Full product details: category, images, variants and approved reviews.
Submit a public contact message.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "سارة أحمد",
    "email": "demo.client@example.com",
    "phone": "+966 50 555 8866",
    "subject": "استفسار عن منتج",
    "message": "مرحباً، أود الاستفسار عن توفر عطر العود الكلاسيكي بحجم 100 مل."
}

request.description: Create an account. Stores the returned token in the apiToken collection variable.
Log in with email or phone. Seed credentials: customer@example.com / password. Stores the token.
Send an OTP to the phone. The response includes a debug_otp while the SMS provider is pending.
Verify the 4-digit OTP (use the OTP from the forgot-password debug response).
Reset the password using the verified OTP.
Revoke the current token and clear apiToken. This request needs a valid bearer token.
Authenticated profile with stats and saved addresses.
Update name/email/phone and optionally upload an avatar file.
Change the password (current_password must match).
Permanently delete the account and revoke all tokens.
The payment methods supported by the app, read from the DB catalog (VISA, MADA, Apple Pay, card).
Submit a review. One review per user per product (updateOrCreate). Awaits admin approval.
List the authenticated user wishlist products.
Add a product to the wishlist.
Remove a product from the wishlist.
Cart summary with items, totals and applied coupon.
Add a product (and optional variant) to the cart.
Update an existing cart item quantity (1-99).
Remove an item from the cart.
Apply a coupon. Seed codes: WELCOME15, WINTER30, SAVE50.
Remove the applied coupon.
The authenticated user address book.
Add a new address. label: home | work | other.
Update address fields.
Delete an address.
Mark an address as the default delivery address.

query.description: Optional status filter: pending | confirmed | processing | in_transit | delivered | cancelled

request.description: Paginated list of the user orders.
Place an order from the cart. payment_method: VISA | MADA | Apple Pay | card (must be in the supported catalog).
Order detail with items, totals and timeline.
Invoice-style summary of the order.
Paginated notifications plus unread_count.
Mark a single notification as read.
Mark every unread notification as read.
